# Appellation

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Appellation`](gmeow-Appellation.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Appellation>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/names`](../../slices/names.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A name as an information object borne by an entity — a person's name, a filename, a place name, an organization name. It carries the surface form ([`gmeow:fullName`](../properties/gmeow-fullName.md)) and the structured parts ([`gmeow:hasNamePart`](../properties/gmeow-hasNamePart.md)); who uses it, toward whom, in what register and over what period is carried by [`gmeow:NameUsage`](gmeow-NameUsage.md). The universal superclass reconciling the scattered naming terms. Multiple appellations on one entity are CO-EQUAL — none is canonical or 'primary'.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md), [`ontolex:LexicalEntry`](http://www.w3.org/ns/lemon/ontolex#LexicalEntry)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:Appellation`](gmeow-Appellation.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md), [`ontolex:LexicalEntry`](http://www.w3.org/ns/lemon/ontolex#LexicalEntry). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the universal name-object umbrella when bearing a name on any entity and a more specific kind ([`PersonName`](gmeow-PersonName.md), [`PlaceName`](gmeow-PlaceName.md), [`Filename`](gmeow-Filename.md)) does not apply, or when modelling a name's surface form and structured parts independently of who uses it.

### Avoid when

- Avoid typing a name-bearing fact's CONTEXT here (audience, register, period live on [`gmeow:NameUsage`](gmeow-NameUsage.md)) and avoid bare [`gmeow:Appellation`](gmeow-Appellation.md) when a specific subkind fits; never treat one of an entity's many appellations as canonical or primary.

### How to use

- Mint one [`Appellation`](gmeow-Appellation.md) per co-equal name, give it [`gmeow:fullName`](../properties/gmeow-fullName.md) plus [`gmeow:nameLanguage`](../properties/gmeow-nameLanguage.md), decompose into typed [`gmeow:NamePart`](gmeow-NamePart.md), and bear it with [`gmeow:hasAppellation`](../properties/gmeow-hasAppellation.md) (or a subkind property); promote to a [`gmeow:NameUsage`](gmeow-NameUsage.md) only when audience, register, or evidence must be first-class.

### Examples

- ex:gennyAunt a [`gmeow:Appellation`](gmeow-Appellation.md); [`gmeow:fullName`](../properties/gmeow-fullName.md) "Aunt Genny"; [`gmeow:hasNamePart`](../properties/gmeow-hasNamePart.md) ex:gennyGiven.
